ai.literal: For doing, difficult, what things exist than friendship? That like, for action, difficult, what things exist as protection?
ai.translation: What is more difficult to form than friendship? And what offers a stronger defense for one's actions than that?
ai.modern: நட்பை விட உருவாக்குவதற்கு கடினமானவை எவை உள்ளன? அதுபோல ஒருவருடைய செயல்களுக்கு பாதுகாப்பாக அமைவதில் நட்பை விடச் சிறந்தவை எவை உள்ளன?
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of true friendship. The first line asks what is harder to build and maintain than a genuine friendship. The second line parallels this by asking what can provide a better defense or protection for one's endeavors than such a friendship. The word 'காப்பு' emphasizes that a good friend acts as a shield, safeguarding one's actions and life.

ai.literal: Waxing nature, good-natured ones' friendship; crescent moon's waning nature, fools' friendship.
ai.translation: Friendship with the wise grows steadily like the waxing crescent moon. Friendship with fools shrinks like the waning moon.
ai.modern: நற்பண்பு உடையவர்களின் நட்பு வளரும் பிறை நிலவைப் போன்றது. அறிவற்றவர்களின் நட்பு முழுநிலவிலிருந்து தேயும் நிலவைப் போன்றது.
ai.explanation: This couplet contrasts the friendships of the wise and the foolish using the phases of the moon. 'நிறைநீர' (waxing nature) describes how friendship with good-natured people starts small but grows steadily over time. Conversely, 'பின்னீர' (waning nature) shows how friendship with fools may start full and intense but inevitably diminishes and fades away.

ai.literal: Every time reading, book's pleasure like, every time associating, good character possessors' friendship.
ai.translation: The friendship of people with good character brings greater joy the more you associate with them, just as a good book brings greater pleasure the more you read it.
ai.modern: நல்ல பண்புகளை உடையவர்களின் நட்பு, பழகப் பழக இன்பம் தருவது; அது நல்ல நூல்களைப் படிக்கப் படிக்க அவற்றின் பொருள் இன்பம் தருவதைப் போன்றது.
ai.explanation: This couplet compares the friendship of noble people to the experience of reading a great book. Just as a good book reveals deeper meanings and gives more pleasure with every reading, true friendship grows richer and more joyful with continuous association. The parallel words 'naviltoṟum' (every time one reads) and 'payiltoṟum' (every time one associates) emphasize this continuous growth of joy.

ai.literal: Laughing purpose-of is-not befriending, excess-at forward having-gone rebuking purpose-of.
ai.translation: Friendship is not made just for the purpose of laughing together; it is for the purpose of stepping forward to rebuke when a friend goes astray.
ai.modern: நட்பு கொள்வது ஒருவரோடு ஒருவர் சிரித்து மகிழ்வதற்காக மட்டும் அல்ல; நண்பர் தவறு செய்யும் போது, முந்திச் சென்று அவரைத் திருத்துவதற்காகவே ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the true purpose of friendship. It clarifies that making friends is not merely for sharing jokes and enjoying each other's company. Rather, the core value of friendship lies in taking the initiative to intervene and correct a friend when they overstep boundaries or make mistakes. The word 'இடித்தல்' (rebuking or striking) powerfully conveys the firm, corrective action a true friend must take.

ai.literal: Association (and) interacting are not needed; mutual feeling indeed friendship becoming right will give.
ai.translation: Constant association and close interaction are not necessary. Mutual understanding alone grants the intimate rights of friendship.
ai.modern: உடலால் ஒன்றாகச் சேர்ந்து பழகுதல் நட்புக்குத் தேவையில்லை; இருவருக்கும் இடையிலான ஒத்த உணர்வே நட்புக்கு உரிய உரிமையைத் தரும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet redefines the basis of true friendship by separating it from physical proximity. It states that constantly meeting ('புணர்ச்சி') and spending time together ('பழகுதல்') are not required to form a bond. Instead, it is the alignment of minds and mutual empathy ('உணர்ச்சி') that truly grants the rights and intimacy ('கிழமை') of friendship. The emphasis is entirely on emotional and intellectual connection over mere physical presence.

ai.literal: face to-smile befriending friendship-is-not heart's inside to-smile befriending friendship
ai.translation: Friendship is not befriending someone just to bring a smile to the face. True friendship is befriending them so that the heart smiles from within.
ai.modern: முகம் மட்டும் மலரும்படி நட்பு கொள்வது உண்மையான நட்பு ஆகாது. நெஞ்சத்தின் உள்ளே மகிழ்ச்சி மலரும்படி நட்பு கொள்வதே உண்மையான நட்பு ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the depth of true friendship by contrasting outward expressions with inner feelings. The poet explains that merely smiling with the face and showing outward affection does not constitute real friendship. True friendship occurs only when the heart rejoices from within, indicating genuine love and sincere connection. The repetition of the word for smiling emphasizes the difference between superficial acquaintance and deep emotional bonds.

ai.literal: From ruin having removed those (bad things), having led on the path, at the time of ruin suffering sorrow is friendship.
ai.translation: True friendship removes a friend from ruinous ways, guides them onto the right path, and shares their sorrow in times of unavoidable ruin.
ai.modern: அழிவைத் தரும் செயல்களிலிருந்து நண்பனை விலக்கி, அவனை நல்ல வழியில் செலுத்தி, அவனுக்கு ஒரு துன்பம் வரும்போது அவனுடன் சேர்ந்து அத்துன்பத்தைப் பகிர்ந்துகொள்வதே உண்மையான நட்பாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the active and supportive nature of true friendship. The first half emphasizes moral guidance: a friend removes one from ruinous paths and steers them toward the right way. The second half highlights unwavering support during unavoidable hardships: if ruin still strikes, true friendship means sharing and enduring that sorrow together. The word 'உழப்பது' conveys a deep, shared toiling or suffering, showing that a friend does not abandon one in distress.

ai.literal: Garment he who lost hand like right then distress that which removes is friendship.
ai.translation: True friendship is that which instinctively hastens to remove distress, just like the hand that instantly moves to catch a slipping garment.
ai.modern: உடை நழுவியவனின் கை எப்படி உடனே சென்று மானத்தைக் காக்கிறதோ, அதுபோல நண்பனுக்குத் துன்பம் வந்தவுடனே சென்று அதனைப் போக்குவதே உண்மையான நட்பாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the spontaneous and protective nature of true friendship through a highly relatable physical reflex. It uses the vivid image of a person's garment slipping off (உடுக்கை இழந்தவன்). Just as the hand instinctively and instantly moves to catch the falling clothes to protect one's modesty, a true friend acts immediately to remove a companion's distress (இடுக்கண் களைவது). The word 'ஆங்கே' (right then and there) emphasizes the immediacy and reflex-like speed of this support, showing that true friendship requires no hesitation or prompting.

ai.literal: For friendship, the exalted seat, what is it if asked? Without wavering, in possible opportunities, the supporting state.
ai.translation: If asked what is the crowning throne of friendship, it is the state of unwavering support in every possible way.
ai.modern: நட்பிற்கு மிகச் சிறந்த நிலை எதுவென்றால், மனம் மாறுபடுதல் இல்லாமல் தம்மால் முடிந்த வழிகளில் எல்லாம் நண்பருக்குத் துணையாக நிற்கும் நிலையாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the highest honor or crowning glory of true friendship. The compound 'வீற்றிருக்கை' (exalted seat or throne) metaphorically represents the ultimate position a friendship can attain. The word 'கொட்பு' can mean spinning or changing, but here it takes the sense of wavering or shifting one's mind, emphasizing steadfast loyalty. 'ஒல்லும் வாய்' refers to every possible opportunity or means. Thus, the pinnacle of friendship is the unwavering, constant commitment to support a friend in every possible way.

ai.literal: "Of this nature they [are] to us, of this nature we [are]" saying, even if praised, worthless will say friendship.
ai.translation: Even if praised by saying, "They mean this much to us, and we mean this much to them," such friendship will be considered worthless.
ai.modern: இவர் நமக்கு இவ்வளவு நெருக்கமானவர், நாம் இவருக்கு இவ்வளவு நெருக்கமானவர்கள் என்று வார்த்தைகளால் புகழ்ந்து கூறினாலும், அந்த நட்பு சிறப்பற்றது என்றே கருதப்படும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes that true friendship transcends verbal expression and boasting. When friends feel the need to constantly measure and praise their bond by saying 'they are this much to us, and we are this much to them,' it reveals an artificiality. Genuine affection is felt deeply and silently; decorating it with words only makes the friendship appear cheap and insignificant.
